scripts.start: echo 'PRODUCTION | Starting stream-cam servers...' && ENVIRONMENT=PRODUCTION bun server.ts & ENVIRONMENT=PRODUCTION bun uiServer.ts &
scripts.dev: echo 'DEVELOPMENT | Starting stream-cam servers...' && ENVIRONMENT=DEVELOPMENT bun server.ts & ENVIRONMENT=DEVELOPMENT bun uiServer.ts &
scripts.stop: echo 'Stopping stream-cam servers...' && lsof -i tcp:80 | awk 'NR!=1 {print $2}' | xargs kill && lsof -i tcp:20240 | awk 'NR!=1 {print $2}' | xargs kill
scripts.prep: echo 'Preparing stream-cam for push...' && echo '[]' > ./mediamtx/config/settings.json && echo '' > ./mediamtx/config/current.txt
